lines.en: Luisa, listen to this! When I got to the shop on Rundle Street, the police had already arrived.
lines.pt: Luisa, escute só! Quando cheguei à loja na Rundle Street, a polícia já tinha chegado.

lines.en: The police? What had happened? Had somebody broken into the shop?
lines.pt: A polícia? O que tinha acontecido? Alguém tinha arrombado a loja?

lines.en: Yes. The owner told me the thief had smashed the window and taken the cash before anyone noticed.
lines.pt: Sim. O dono me contou que o ladrão tinha quebrado a janela e levado o dinheiro antes que alguém notasse.

lines.en: That is terrible. Did the alarm go off, or had it been switched off?
lines.pt: Que horror. O alarme disparou, ou tinha sido desligado?

lines.en: It had been switched off by the thief, apparently. By the time the owner came downstairs, he had vanished.
lines.pt: Tinha sido desligado pelo ladrão, ao que parece. Quando o dono desceu, ele já tinha sumido.

lines.en: So when the police arrived, the thief had already gone. Did anybody see him?
lines.pt: Então, quando a polícia chegou, o ladrão já tinha ido embora. Alguém o viu?

lines.en: A neighbour saw a man in a dark jacket. He had been standing near the corner for twenty minutes.
lines.pt: Um vizinho viu um homem de jaqueta escura. Ele estava parado perto da esquina havia vinte minutos.

lines.en: Then the police must have found something useful. Had the camera across the road recorded him?
lines.pt: Então a polícia deve ter encontrado algo útil. A câmera do outro lado da rua tinha gravado ele?

lines.en: They are checking now. The footage showed that he had run towards the tram stop after he had left the shop.
lines.pt: Estão verificando agora. As imagens mostraram que ele tinha corrido para o ponto de bonde depois de sair da loja.

lines.en: Let’s hope they catch him soon. After he had taken the money, did he drop anything?
lines.pt: Vamos torcer para pegarem logo. Depois de ter levado o dinheiro, ele deixou cair alguma coisa?

lines.en: Only a glove. The detective said it might help them identify him by tomorrow evening.
lines.pt: Só uma luva. O detetive disse que isso pode ajudar a identificá-lo até amanhã à noite.

items.wrong: When I arrived, the thief already went.
items.fix: When I arrived, the thief had already gone.
items.why: Use had + participle for the earlier action.

items.wrong: The police arrived after the thief left.
items.fix: The police arrived after the thief had left.
items.why: After + past perfect is common for the first action.

items.wrong: Did she had told you before?
items.why: In questions, had goes before the subject.

teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.

group: Compare erro e forma natural: When I arrived, the thief already went. → When I arrived, the thief had already gone. | The police arrived after the thief left. → The police arrived after the thief had left. | Did she had told you before? → Had she told you before?.
Peça que digam a forma natural em voz alta.
extra90: Cada aluno cria um erro típico seu e o grupo corrige.

facts.big: when/by the time + passado simples, had + particípio
facts.label: Sequência com past perfect
facts.sub: Fato mais antigo: had gone, had smashed. Fato mais recente: arrived, came. Conectores: when, by the time, after, before, already.

facts.label: Ordem dos fatos
facts.sub: Use o past perfect para a ação mais antiga e o passado simples para a mais recente: When the police arrived, the thief had gone. A ordem das orações não muda a ordem real dos fatos.

facts.label: Quando… já
facts.sub: By the time liga um fato a um limite no passado: By the time the owner came downstairs, he had vanished. Em português, é “quando… já”. Use have + particípio no passado.

facts.label: Had been + particípio
facts.sub: No relato de crimes, o passivo aparece muito: The alarm had been switched off. The window had been smashed. O agente nem sempre importa; o fato importa mais.

facts.label: Conectores
facts.sub: After the thief had left, the police arrived. Before the police arrived, the thief had gone. Com after e before, você escolhe qual fato vem primeiro na frase. O significado não muda.

compare.br: Em português, “quando cheguei, ele já tinha saído” usa o mais-que-perfeito, que é pouco falado.
compare.us: Em inglês, o past perfect é natural: When I arrived, he had already left.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: He had already left.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The past perfect shows the earlier of two past actions.
We say “When I arrived, he left already”.
items.why: We say he had already left.

items.s: By the time + passado simples often needs the past perfect.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The past perfect shows the earlier of two past actions. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “When I arrived, he left already”. → Falso (We say he had already left.)
By the time + passado simples often needs the past perfect. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 2/2

items.s: Had been switched off is a past perfect passive.
The past perfect is only used with the word before.
items.why: It is used with when, after, by the time and more.

answers: Had been switched off is a past perfect passive. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
The past perfect is only used with the word before. → Falso (It is used with when, after, by the time and more.)
